readme:
# ElevenLabs Music v2.5

ElevenLabs Music v2.5: the newest ElevenLabs music model, with vocals and full arrangements up to 10 minutes.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string, required | — | Genre, mood, instruments, vocals, and lyrics. |
| `force_instrumental` | boolean | false | Generate without vocals. |
| `music_length_ms` | integer 3000–600000 | — | Length in milliseconds (3,000–600,000). |

## Billing

$0.75 per started minute, with a one-minute minimum. Without `music_length_ms` the quote assumes 1 minute.

| Length | Price |
|---|---|
| 30s | $0.75 |
| 60s | $0.75 |
| 150s | $2.25 |
| 600s | $7.50 |

Failed runs are not charged.

## Prompting

- Describe structure and vocals; put lyrics in the prompt if you need exact words.

## Limits

- Up to 10 minutes.

## Also on SandBase

Other ElevenLabs Music versions: `elevenlabs/music`, `elevenlabs/music/2`.
